description: Use this when the user names Clothing, Models, Locations, art directions, files or past results in chat and you need their ids. Takes a short keyword query (2-5 words, or an exact name, SKU or id) and returns typed ids, names and thumbnails. It finds items; it does not recommend them. Changes nothing.

inputSchema.description: Input schema for universal hybrid library search.

exclude_clothing_item_ids.description: Exclude these garment IDs after ranking and before the result limit; other item types are unaffected.

item_types.description: Optional item types to search. Omit to search clothing, avatars/models, locations, art directions, uploaded files, and generation results.

limit.description: Maximum number of hybrid matches to return

query.description: Short keyword query: 2 to 5 words, one concept per call, or an exact name/SKU/ID. Every word must match for lexical results, so long sentences can return no lexical matches. Describing a garment finds that garment, not pieces to pair with it.

refresh_index.description: Deprecated compatibility input. No index refresh is performed, even when true. Search uses the maintained index and current lexical metadata. Leave false.

name: search_uwear_library
title: Search Library
